component.name: ScheduleFetcher
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "run" end sub
sub run() xfer = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") xfer.SetUrl(m.top.apiBase + "/api/schedule/live") xfer.SetCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") xfer.InitClientCertificates() xfer.SetRequest("GET") resp = xfer.GetToString() if resp = invalid or resp = "" m.top.error = "Could not reach network" return end if data = ParseJson(resp) if data = invalid m.top.error = "Invalid schedule data" return end if m.top.result = data end sub
